# A deposit that arrives net of a bank fee: 95.00 reaches the account, 5.00 is
# charged, and the customer is credited with the full 100.00. Two splits are
# not the bank's side, and only one of them is the payment.
2026-01-01 open Expenses:Bank Fees
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

2026-02-05 * "Acme — payment less the wire fee"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank 95.00 CAD
		memo: "Payment"
	Expenses:Bank Fees 5.00 CAD
		memo: "Wire fee"
	Assets:Accounts Receivable -100.00 CAD
